en.title: Google Pixel 6 Case - Phone Case with Dual-Layer Shock-Absorbing Protection - Stormy Sky
bullets: Display size: 6.4 inches.Exclusively designed for Pixel 6 phones
Dual-layer shock-absorbing case with raised edges
Translucent material lets the phone shine through
en.description: The Pixel 6 Case highlights your Pixel’s design while keeping it protected. This dual-layer shock-absorbing phone case defends against drops and scratches. It comes in three translucent colors, so you can choose the one that fits your personal style. And it works with wireless charging, too.[1] [1]Cases may interfere with charging and will reduce charging speed.
